title: Drain Filter Service: Fix It First Time
description: A 10-minute refresher that helps field technicians fix most drain complaints in one visit.

screens.title: Fix it first time
screens.subtitle: Clear most 'water not draining' complaints in under 10 minutes, safely, in one visit.
objectives: Check the drain filter before replacing any part
Service a drain filter safely in four steps
Match common symptoms to their likely cause
Turn a fixed machine into a happy, informed customer
screens.narration: Welcome. In the next ten minutes you'll learn the one check that fixes half of all drain complaints, and how to do it safely every time.

screens.title: Why the filter comes first
screens.intro: The numbers from our service visits make a strong case.

parts.title: of drain complaints
parts.text: are fixed by cleaning the filter alone.

parts.title: or less on site
parts.text: for a complete filter clean and test.

parts.title: of water comes out
parts.text: when you open the filter cover.

screens.narration: About half of all drain complaints are solved by cleaning the filter. It takes under ten minutes, so always check it before you replace the pump.

screens.title: Do it safely
screens.subtitle: Four steps, one towel and a shallow tray.
screens.narration: Let's start with the procedure, and with keeping you and the customer's home safe.

screens.title: The 4-step filter service

parts.title: Unplug
parts.text: Pull the plug. Switching off at the panel isn't enough.

parts.title: Drain
parts.text: Towel and shallow tray under the cover: 1 to 2 litres will come out.

parts.title: Clean
parts.text: Remove lint, coins and hair pins; rinse the filter.

parts.title: Refit and test
parts.text: Screw it in firmly and run a short drain cycle.

screens.narration: Unplug, drain, clean, then refit and test. Always unplug first, and put a towel and a shallow tray down, because up to two litres of water will come out.

screens.title: Safety on site

parts.title: Do
parts.text:
Unplug the machine, not just switch it off
Let hot water cool before opening
Wipe up spills straight away

parts.title: Don't
parts.text:
Open the filter with the machine plugged in
Unscrew the cover over a bare floor
Leave water where someone could slip

screens.narration: Here's what safe work looks like on the left, and the shortcuts that cause accidents on the right.

screens.title: Before you open the cover
screens.narration: Tick each item as you go. Make this your habit before every filter service.

screens.question: You arrive and the drum is full of water. What do you do first?
options: Open the filter cover to drain it
screens.explanation: Always unplug first. Then put down a towel and tray before opening the filter.
screens.narration: Quick practice question before we move on.

screens.title: Find the real cause
screens.subtitle: Not every drain problem is the filter. Read the symptoms.
screens.narration: Now let's make sure you fix the right thing.

screens.title: Four symptoms to recognise

parts.title: Water left in the drum
parts.text: Most often a blocked filter.

parts.title: Loud humming, no drain
parts.text: A coin or object is stuck in the pump.

parts.title: Error code F21 / E21
parts.text: Drain timeout: clean the filter, then check the hose.

parts.title: Slow drain only
parts.text: Usually a kinked drain hose.

screens.narration: These four symptoms cover most visits. Notice that two of them point straight at the filter.

screens.title: Filter or hose?
screens.instruction: Decide where you'd look first for each symptom.
screens.narration: Sort each symptom by where you'd look first. Think it through before you check.

screens.title: Mrs Sharma's machine
screens.situation: Mrs Sharma says her front loader stopped mid-wash with water in the drum and an E21 code. Her son already ordered a new pump online. What do you do?

choices.text: Fit the new pump since it's already here
choices.feedback: Half of drain complaints are a blocked filter. Check it first: it takes under 10 minutes.

choices.text: Unplug, drain and clean the filter, then test
choices.feedback: Right. E21 is a drain timeout, so the filter is the first check. The pump may not be needed at all.

choices.text: Tell her to call back after the pump arrives
choices.feedback: You can likely fix it today. Clean the filter first, then decide.

screens.narration: Here's a real situation. Read it carefully and choose what you'd do.

screens.title: Leave a happy customer
screens.subtitle: The fix is half the job. The conversation is the other half.
screens.narration: Finally, how you finish the visit matters as much as the repair.

screens.title: What matters, in order

parts.title: Offer the AMC
parts.text: Only after the problem is fixed and the customer is happy.

parts.title: Teach monthly cleaning
parts.text: Show how to clean the filter themselves.

parts.title: Show what you removed
parts.text: Lint, coins and pins make the problem real.

parts.title: Fix it safely, first time
parts.text: Everything else depends on this.

screens.narration: Build the visit from the bottom up: fix it safely, show and teach, and only then recommend the annual maintenance contract.

screens.title: The customer conversation

parts.title: Listen first
parts.text: Ask what happened and when it started.

parts.title: Explain as you work
parts.text: Tell them what you're checking and why.

parts.title: Show and teach
parts.text: Hand over what you removed; demo monthly cleaning.

screens.title: Five things to remember
points: Check the drain filter before replacing any part
Unplug first; towel and tray before opening
E21 / F21 means drain timeout: filter, then hose
Show what you removed and teach monthly cleaning
Offer the AMC only once the customer is happy
screens.narration: Here are the five things to take to your next visit. Then a short check to finish.

screens.question: About what share of drain complaints are fixed by cleaning the filter?
screens.explanation: Around half, which is why the filter is always the first check.
screens.narration: Question one.

screens.question: Why put a towel and a shallow tray down before opening the filter cover?
options: To catch the 1 to 2 litres of water that come out
To protect the customer's floor from scratches
It's only needed for top loaders
screens.explanation: One to two litres of water drain out when the cover opens.
screens.narration: Question two.

screens.question: A machine shows error E21 and drains slowly. What's the best order of checks?
screens.explanation: E21 is a drain timeout: clean the filter first, then check the hose.
screens.narration: Question three.

screens.question: When should you recommend the annual maintenance contract?
options: After the problem is fixed and the customer is happy
screens.explanation: Offer the AMC once you've fixed the problem and the customer is satisfied.
screens.narration: Last question.
